topPRs.title: Add SINC token on Base
topPRs.author: OrderofChaos33
topPRs.body:
Adds SINC (0x9C8cd8d3961F445D653713dE65C6578bE11668e7) on Base mainnet.

- Native Base ERC-20 (nobridge: true)
- Website: https://getsincor.com
- Sourcify full-match verified contracts
- CertiK Skynet 97/100
- Fixed 100M supply, 8 decimals, no mint/admin keys
- Official buy venue: bonding curve 0x75dE341a2BC81806198364F125d4Cde36527619C

Do not price from rogue Uniswap V2 pair 0x85372932f9b151a076815d92cf71a97980ffd667.
